items.mainDefect: The comment says the code deletes SMS reminders whose scheduled date has passed, but the new retryCount branch makes that untrue.

secondary.defect: The retryCount > 1 OR branch has no method: WorkflowMethods.SMS filter, so the SMS cron can delete non-SMS reminders (email, WhatsApp).

items.mainDefect: The prisma.workflowReminder.update inside the catch block is not guarded, so if it throws, the loop aborts and the remaining reminders are skipped.

secondary.defect: Setting retryCount to reminder.retryCount + 1 is a stale read-then-write; it should use an atomic { increment: 1 } instead.
